blurb: Gunpowder Golf Course was designed to follow the natural topography of the land in the Scottish tradition. Following rolling hills, and bordered by trees on every hole, the course is a challenge for golfers of all skill levels. The course opened in 1956 and is the oldest golf course in Prince George's County.
